meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行操作开发工作区与终端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常切换开发工作区并用终端执行操作。
copy.tagline_en: Manage dev worktrees and terminals from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often switch between dev worktrees and use terminal commands.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 orca 命令行操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、内置浏览器等。它会先解析正确的可执行文件,再用 `ORCA skills get orca-cli` 获取完整指南后执行命令,不再直接用 git worktree 等工具。
howto.when: 当你说出"$orca-cli"、"use orca cli"、"Orca worktree" 等触发词,或要求操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、内置浏览器等状态时触发。此时优先于 git worktree、Playwright 等通用工具。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 列出所有 Orca 工作树
say.note: 会先获取完整指南再运行对应命令。

say.text: 把当前任务移交给另一个 worktree 里的 agent
